subject: Staged opt-in plan for model family consolidation — comms & exception ladder
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-12T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Staged opt-in plan for model family consolidation — comms & exception ladder

Team —

I want to align on a lightweight staged opt-in approach for the upcoming model family consolidation (target window Q4). Goal: allow customers to opt into the consolidated variant in controlled waves, reduce blast radius, and provide an explicit exception ladder for legacy endpoints that cannot migrate in time. High-level asks:

- Product: confirm which endpoint paths map to the consolidated model family and whether the compat shim can be kept for 90 days after cutover.
- Ops: confirm earliest canary date for a 1% traffic canary and rollback steps.
- Comms: draft a short customer notice + an opt-in CTA flow (email + console banner).
- Legal/Procurement: any contract-level notices for customers with committed SKUs?

Attached a first draft MAP (staged-opt-in-MAP-v1.xlsx) and a customer notice draft. Please reply with concrete constraints by EOD Friday so we can lock dates with Acme (they asked for a schedule).

Quick proposal:
1) Week 0: internal canary (non-customer) + smoke tests.
2) Week 1: 1% opt-in wave for customers who proactively opt in.
3) Week 3: 10% broaden, monitoring review.
4) Week 6: full redirect for remaining non-exempt endpoints.

Exceptions: we should define an exemption intake form (tech & contract reason) and an auto-escalation to SE + Eng after 7 days.

Thanks — Sean
--
Sean Gallagher
Director, GTM Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-12T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staged opt-in plan for model family consolidation — comms & exception ladder

Sean — thanks for the plan. A few product/engineering constraints to call out:

- Endpoint mapping: /v1/generate and /v1/chat will map to consolidated-family-v2; /v1/legacy_embed is incompatible and must be treated as an exemption candidate. I'll add a mapping sheet in the MAP.
- Compat shim: we can maintain a lightweight shim for 60 days post-cutover (not 90) unless the customer is on a dedicated/private deployment — in which case we should offer a 120-day bridge and a paid migration engagement.
- Canary: Ops can run an internal canary next Tuesday (09/15). Customer-facing canary (1% opt-ins) needs a freeze window for model weights & a rollback tag—engineering will need the exact list of customers so we can pin configurations.
- Metrics: define SLOs for latency and token error rate (I suggest 95th latency delta < 30ms and model quality alerts measured by eval prompt set). If opt-in causes regression, auto-fallback to prior variant for that customer for 24h while SE triages.

One ask from product roadmap: we have a competing rollout for quantization profiles the week after cutover. If we try to do both, risk increases. Recommend we separate them by at least 3 weeks.

I added inline comments in the MAP and set the canary date.

Irene
Staff PM, Serving Platform

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-12T12:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staged opt-in plan for model family consolidation — comms & exception ladder

This looks good. For comms, suggested cadence and assets:

- Customer notice (two versions): Notice A (opt-in invite + benefits) and Notice B (forced migration + exception path). Keep Notice A lightweight ~3 bullets + CTA.
- Console banner: a short on-product CTA that surfaces opt-in and links to the MAP.
- Dedicated customers: personal outreach from AE + an official email from me outlining migration assistance.
- Internal playbooks: a 1-pager for CS/SE with standard responses and escalation steps.

Draft subject lines: "Action required: Opt-in to consolidated model family (early access)" and "Upcoming model consolidation: opt-in window & support" — open to alternatives.

Timing: if Irene's canary is 09/15, we can send Notice A to the opt-in cohort on 09/16 and open the console CTA on 09/17. Please confirm legal on the wording re: SLAs.

Attached: customer-notice-draft.txt (comments inline).

Marissa
Director, Customer Communications

From: Sara Jones <sara.jones@acme.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-13T09:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staged opt-in plan for model family consolidation — comms & exception ladder

Thanks Sean — Acme is interested in early opt-in but we need clarity before committing. A few quick Qs from our side:

- What is the exact opt-in deadline and the expected date of full redirect for non-exempt endpoints?
- Will opting in change retention / logging behavior? We have strict audit requirements.
- For our dedicated integration, will there be a compatibility bridge and any additional cost?

Forwarding this to ops-team and procurement to capture their asks; please include the MAP and any SLA deltas.

Date: 2026-09-14T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Staged opt-in plan for model family consolidation — comms & exception ladder

Summarizing decisions and next steps after PR comments:

- Canary: internal canary scheduled 2026-09-15; customer-facing opt-in wave (1%) scheduled 2026-09-16.
- Compat shim: 60-day default bridge. Dedicated/private customers get 120-day bridge with optional paid migration.
- Separation: quantization profile rollout moved to 3 weeks after full redirect to reduce risk.
- MAP: Sean will publish the MAP (staged-opt-in-MAP-v1.xlsx) to the shared drive and we will maintain the intake tracker there. Link: https://drive.redwood.internal/teams/migrations/staged-opt-in-MAP-v1
- Customer comms: Marissa to send Notice A to opt-in cohort on 2026-09-16; console CTA goes live 2026-09-17. Legal to sign off on SLA wording by 2026-09-15 EOD.
- Exceptions: intake form required; triage by SE within 48 hours; auto-escalation to Eng if unresolved in 7 days.

Escalation path: SE -> Product -> Eng Lead (Karthik) -> CTO if customers at risk.

I'll update the HUBSPOT record (HUBSPOT-123456) and add Acme to the opt-in cohort unless we hear otherwise.

Karthik
VP, Serving Platform Operations
